goal.ko: 인사하고 이름을 말하며 못 들은 말을 다시 요청한다
goal.en: Greet someone, give a name, and ask someone to repeat what you did not hear.
goal.de: Begrüße jemanden, nenne einen Namen und bitte um Wiederholung, wenn du etwas nicht gehört hast.

base_manuscript.inheritance: full dialogue, teaching, P/I/R items, answer criteria, help and feedback retained verbatim; overlay is additive

source_contract.title: 처음 만난 사람과 다시 묻기
source_contract.can_do: 인사하고 이름을 말하며 못 들은 말을 다시 요청한다
source_contract.teach: 인사의 기능을 번역과 시범으로 먼저 보이고 이름 뒤 예요·이에요를 나누어 시범; 회복 표현은 통째로 익힘
source_contract.practice: 이름을 일부러 놓친 대화에서 다시 듣기를 요청하고 들은 이름을 확인
source_contract.transfer: 새 상대가 다른 이름을 말할 때 인사·자기 이름·재요청 중 필요한 행동 선택

context.ko: 연습 이름 카드: 민수. 실제 개인정보가 아니에요.
context.en: Practice name card: 민수. This is not personal data.
context.de: Übungsnamenskarte: 민수. Das sind keine persönlichen Daten.

prompt.en: Greet the gatekeeper and introduce yourself using the card.
prompt.de: Begrüße den Torwächter und stelle dich mit dem Namen auf der Karte vor.

required_words_and_senses.sense_ko: 임시 역할 이름, 모음으로 끝나는 감수용 한글 표기
공손한 만남 인사
배운 명사 정체 서술형; 받침별 이름 시범

items.required_control: ORAL-START: choose explanation language; demonstrate play, reply and optional help before task
items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.en: Say the card’s name after your greeting.
level1.de: Nenne nach der Begrüßung den Namen auf der Karte.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 다른 이름이 나왔어요. 카드의 이름을 다시 확인해요. 말이 통했다면 어미는 별도로 살펴봐요.
wrong_feedback.en: That was a different name. Check the card again. If your meaning was clear, we’ll check the ending separately.
wrong_feedback.de: Das war ein anderer Name. Schau noch einmal auf die Karte. Wenn deine Aussage verständlich war, prüfen wir die Endung getrennt.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Accept 저는/저 optional, name+예요/이에요 and appropriate identity alternatives. 입니다 achieves identity but not target ending. Declining disclosure is a preference; offer role card, no error or identity credit.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

context.ko: 새 역할 카드의 음성만 먼저 들어요. 이름 카드에는 읽기 대신 미리 익힌 음성 이름도 있어요.
context.en: First hear the voice of a new role card. Each name card also has a previously introduced audio label.
context.de: Hör zuerst die Stimme einer neuen Rollenkarte. Jede Namenskarte hat auch eine zuvor eingeführte Audiobeschriftung.

prompt.en: Choose the card with the name you heard.
prompt.de: Wähle die Karte mit dem Namen, den du gehört hast.

required_words_and_senses.sense_ko: 임시 역할 이름, 모음으로 끝나는 감수용 한글 표기
임시 역할 이름, 받침으로 끝나는 감수용 한글 표기

items.required_control: ORAL-START: choose explanation language; demonstrate play, reply and optional help before task
items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.ko: 같은 음성을 다시 들을 수 있어요.
level1.en: You can replay the same audio.
level1.de: Du kannst dieselbe Aufnahme noch einmal hören.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 이름이 달라요. 같은 녹음을 한 번 더 듣고 두 이름을 비교해요.
wrong_feedback.en: That is a different name. Hear the same recording again and compare the two names.
wrong_feedback.de: Das ist ein anderer Name. Hör dieselbe Aufnahme noch einmal und vergleiche die beiden Namen.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Audio asset says 민수예요.; exact matching learned name card required. Name-card audio help logs response support; no reading/speech inference.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

context.ko: 상대가 이름을 말할 때 이야기 속 바람 소리 때문에 마지막 말을 놓쳤어요. 재생 오류를 학습자 탓으로 돌리지 않아요.
context.en: In the story, wind covered the end of the partner’s name. A playback fault is not a learner error.
context.de: In der Geschichte hat Wind das Ende des Namens übertönt. Ein Wiedergabefehler ist kein Lernfehler.

prompt.en: Ask the partner to say the same thing again.
prompt.de: Bitte die andere Person, dasselbe noch einmal zu sagen.

required_words_and_senses.sense_ko: 상대의 같은 발화를 다시 요청

items.required_control: ORAL-START: choose explanation language; demonstrate play, reply and optional help before task
items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.en: Ask for repetition instead of guessing the name.
level1.de: Bitte um Wiederholung, statt den Namen zu erraten.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 지금 필요한 것은 새 소개가 아니라 같은 말을 다시 듣는 일이에요.
wrong_feedback.en: You need to hear the same words again here.
wrong_feedback.de: Hier brauchst du dieselben Worte noch einmal.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Accept 다시 말해 주세요 / 한 번 더 말해 주세요 / appropriate repeat request. Optional selection records recognition only. After request, exact previous full name recording replays, then acknowledgment.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

context.ko: 이번에는 문지기 역할의 상대가 자기 이름을 말할 차례예요.
context.en: Now it is the gatekeeper’s turn to introduce himself.
context.de: Jetzt ist der Torwächter mit seiner Vorstellung dran.

required_words_and_senses.sense_ko: 사람의 이름·정체를 묻는 전체 표현

wrong_feedback.en: Giving a name and asking for one have different jobs. Try the question.
wrong_feedback.de: Einen Namen nennen und danach fragen sind verschiedene Handlungen. Probiere die Frage.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Accept 누구예요? / 이름이 뭐예요? in polite roleplay. Dokk replies 도깨비예요 as translated story line, not required vocabulary recall. Real known relationship is unchanged.

context.ko: 이번에는 문지기 역할의 상대가 자기 이름을 말할 차례예요.
context.en: Now it is the gatekeeper’s turn to introduce himself.
context.de: Jetzt ist der Torwächter mit seiner Vorstellung dran.

required_words_and_senses.sense_ko: 사람의 이름·정체를 묻는 전체 표현

items.required_control: ORAL-START: choose explanation language; demonstrate play, reply and optional help before task
items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.en: Recall the whole expression for asking who someone is.
level1.de: Erinnere dich an den ganzen Ausdruck, mit dem du nach einer Person fragst.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 이름을 말하는 답과 이름을 묻는 질문은 역할이 달라요. 질문을 해 봐요.
wrong_feedback.en: Giving a name and asking for one have different jobs. Try the question.
wrong_feedback.de: Einen Namen nennen und danach fragen sind verschiedene Handlungen. Probiere die Frage.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Accept 누구예요? / 이름이 뭐예요? in polite roleplay. Dokk replies 도깨비예요 as translated story line, not required vocabulary recall. Real known relationship is unchanged.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

assisted.ko: 도움을 받아 이 활동을 함께 마쳤어요. 다른 예는 준비되면 해 봐요.
assisted.en: You completed this activity with support. Try another example when you are ready.
assisted.de: Du hast diese Aufgabe mit Hilfe abgeschlossen. Probiere ein weiteres Beispiel, wenn du bereit bist.

independent.ko: 이 예는 시범 없이 확인했어요. 다른 날 새로운 상황에서도 다시 해 봐요.
independent.en: You checked this example without a model. Try it in a new setting another day.
independent.de: Du hast dieses Beispiel ohne Vorlage bearbeitet. Probiere es an einem anderen Tag in einer neuen Situation.

audio_unavailable.ko: 지금은 소리를 재생할 수 없어요. 글과 그림으로 계속하거나 나중에 다시 들어요.
audio_unavailable.en: Audio is unavailable right now. Continue with text and pictures, or listen later.
audio_unavailable.de: Der Ton ist gerade nicht verfügbar. Mach mit Text und Bildern weiter oder höre später noch einmal zu.

pause.ko: 여기서 잠시 쉬어도 괜찮아요. 돌아오면 같은 차례에서 이어가요.
pause.en: You can take a break here. When you return, continue from the same turn.
pause.de: Du kannst hier eine Pause machen. Wenn du zurückkommst, geht es an derselben Stelle weiter.

resume.ko: 돌아왔네요. 놓아 둔 답과 도움 상태를 확인하고 이어가요.
resume.en: Welcome back. Check your previous response and any help you used, then continue.
resume.de: Willkommen zurück. Sieh dir deine bisherige Antwort und die verwendete Hilfe an und mach dann weiter.

save_failed.ko: 아직 저장을 확인하지 못했어요. 지금 답은 유지한 채 다시 시도해요.
save_failed.en: Saving has not been confirmed yet. Keep your response and try again.
save_failed.de: Das Speichern ist noch nicht bestätigt. Deine Antwort bleibt stehen; versuche es erneut.

revisit.ko: 이미 본 장면이에요. 다시 보아도 보상이나 공정이 중복 생성되지 않아요.
revisit.en: You have seen this scene before. Replaying it does not grant another reward or construction step.
revisit.de: Du kennst diese Szene bereits. Beim erneuten Ansehen erhältst du keine weitere Belohnung und keinen zusätzlichen Bauabschnitt.

response_conditions.assisted: only after supported task is resolved
response_conditions.independent: only if the eligible item met its criteria without model/hint; not all modalities
response_conditions.resume: only after original state is actually restored

story.spoiler_guard: Use only revealed facts. First book has no completed Sarangchae; first 집 remains practice draft until original readiness is confirmed.

review.original_review_scope: existing manuscript reviews and same-byte source; not human/native/device approval
